invariants: untrusted input cannot select the environment
untrusted input cannot change the effective target
untrusted input cannot assert reviewer identity or role
untrusted input cannot forge approval quorum
untrusted input cannot assert artifact integrity
untrusted input cannot assert lease ownership or fencing
an infrastructure allow cannot expand capability-specific authority
a policy parse, signature, adapter, or decision failure cannot become allow
a signed bundle cannot trust its own signing key
an emergency overlay can deny but cannot allow
